{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically too high during price declines, requiring 1-2% vertical compression of monthly projections",
    "Sentiment negative values (below 0) directly offset model forecasts by approximately 1-2 points, especially in the first 15-day horizon",
    "When price history shows continuous daily declines, model momentum assumptions overshoot reality by 0.5-1.5 points per day",
    "Mean reversion bias exists where model maintains levels too close to recent averages when experiencing volatility expansion",
    "Sentiment strength metrics (0.67-1.00) amplify model forecasts by 0.5-1.0 points in the near term (first 10 days)",
    "When price range narrows (volatility contraction), model fails to capture velocity effects and over-predicts by 0.3-0.8 points daily",
    "Sentiment divergence from price trend (e.g., rising prices with weak sentiment) requires 0.3-0.7 point forecast reduction"
] }
